ValidationRule.description: SFM-12912: Required field when subreason is 'Sales Experience' on picklist values in the fields: ‘Cancellation Subreason’ or ‘Secondary Cancellation Subreason’
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.skipValidation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "SWAT", OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Subreason__c), ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Sales") ), AND( ISCHANGED(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c), ISPICKVAL(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c, "Sales") ) ), ISBLANK(SalesExperienceNotes__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot leave the Sales Experience Notes field blank
